Pursuant to a Subscription Agreement executed on November 22, 2026 between MicroVision, Inc. ("MicroVision") and the reporting person, the reporting person acquired shares of MicroVision's common stock directly from MicroVision at a purchase price of $0.83 per share, the closing price of MicroVision's common stock on November 20, 2026. || The purchase is intended to be an exempt transaction pursuant to Rule 16b-3.

As the indirect, sole owner of the general partner of Juniper Capital IV, L.P., a Delaware limited partnership and investment fund that wholly owns and controls J PED, LLC ("J PED") in whose name the shares of Common Stock were acquired, the Reporting Person may be deemed to have voting and dispositive power over the securities held by J PED. The Reporting Person disclaims beneficial ownership of the securities except to the extent of his pecuniary interest therein. This report shall not be deemed an admission that the Reporting Person is the beneficial owner of such securities for purposes of Section 16 or for any other purpose.
